text:
Silver Price in 1995
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1995, the LBMA silver price rose 9.5% between 1995-01-31 ($4.70) and 1995-12-29 ($5.14). The highest sampled price was $5.83 in April and the lowest was $4.49 in February. The mean of these observations was $5.20. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
